policy.executionRule: Solutions are advisory metadata; execution still uses validated Agent plans.

solutions.title: Active Comp Context Review

intent.summary: Inspect active composition, selected layers and optional render queue state without changing the project.
appliesWhen: The user asks to summarize the active comp, selected layers or render queue state.
The planner needs compact read-only context before deciding whether a later mutation is safe.

targetAssumptions: The CEP panel may be offline; offline context should be reported instead of guessed.

verificationRecipe.summary: Confirm the plan uses only typed read tools and reports returned context or offline state.

notes: Seeded from the Project Context Snapshot workflow and offline prompt smoke coverage.

promotionHistory.evidence: Milestone 71 seed from existing read-only context snapshot and prompt smoke validation.

notes: This recipe is advisory context only and must not add mutation steps.

solutions.title: Basic Comp Setup Typed Plan

intent.summary: Create one basic composition with explicit size, duration and frame rate, then read it back.
appliesWhen: The user asks to create a simple or basic composition.
The planner needs a narrow comp creation pattern before adding layers or effects.

inputs.name: compSettings
inputs.description: Explicit width, height, duration, frame rate and optional background color.

targetAssumptions: The requested comp is a new generated project item.
The workflow does not require broad comp updates or template batch changes.

verificationRecipe.summary: Read back the created comp and confirm name, dimensions, duration and frame rate.
steps: Compare the returned comp metadata with the requested settings.
expectedEvidence: The created comp reports the expected name, size, duration and frame rate.
The mutating step includes idempotency and read-back verification.

notes: Seeded as a Dakkshin-inspired advisory recipe using existing create_comp typed-tool coverage.

promotionHistory.evidence: Milestone 187 advisory solution-library slice from M186 recommended help/prompt entries.

notes: Advisory recipe only; execution still uses normal Agent plan validation and protected run gates.

solutions.title: Safe Effect Addition Typed Plan

intent.summary: Add an effect to a verified layer with matchName-oriented discovery and effect read-back.
appliesWhen: The user asks to add an effect safely to a selected or explicit layer.
The planner needs effect property details before changing effect values.

inputs.name: targetLayer
inputs.description: Selected layer or explicit layer target verified before adding the effect.

inputs.name: effectMatchName
inputs.description: Known effect matchName; omit when discovery must run first.

targetAssumptions: The target layer is selected or explicitly identified before mutation.

verificationRecipe.summary: Read back the effect instance and, when properties change, verify the exact property target before and after mutation.
steps: Use set_effect_property only after get_effect_details identifies the target property.
Run get_effect_details again after property mutation.
expectedEvidence: The expected effect is present on the verified layer.
Any property change uses property evidence from get_effect_details.

notes: Seeded as a Dakkshin-inspired advisory recipe using existing effect typed-tool coverage.

promotionHistory.evidence: Milestone 187 advisory solution-library slice from M186 recommended help/prompt entries.

notes: The recipe prefers matchName/read-back and must not use display-name-only raw execution.

solutions.title: Selected Layers Animation Typed Plan

intent.summary: Animate selected layers with typed property keyframes, optional ease and read-back verification.
appliesWhen: The user asks to animate selected layers or add basic transform keyframes.
The requested animation fits typed transform or property-keyframe tools.

inputs.name: selectedLayerIndices
inputs.description: Selected layers verified before the animation mutation.

inputs.name: animatedProperties
inputs.description: Requested properties and keyframe values, such as opacity, position, scale or rotation.

targetAssumptions: The selected layers are verified before creating keyframes.

verificationRecipe.summary: Read back selected layer timing and transform/property evidence after the animation mutation.
steps: Run get_selected_layers or list_layers after setting keyframes.
Confirm affected layers and properties match the requested animation intent.
expectedEvidence: The selected layers report the expected animated or adjusted properties.
The plan uses only typed property/transform tools.

notes: Seeded as a Dakkshin-inspired advisory recipe using existing transform and keyframe typed-tool coverage.

promotionHistory.evidence: Milestone 187 advisory solution-library slice from M186 recommended help/prompt entries.

notes: Mask, destructive layer, audio-marker and broad comp changes remain outside this recipe.

solutions.title: Selected Layers Align To CTI

intent.summary: Move selected layers so their timing aligns to the active comp current time indicator.
appliesWhen: The user asks to align selected layers, clips or precomps to the CTI.
The active comp has one or more selected layers.

inputs.name: selectedLayerIndices
inputs.description: Selected layers from get_active_comp or get_selected_layers.

inputs.name: targetTime
inputs.description: Optional explicit target time; omit it to use the active comp CTI.

targetAssumptions: At least one layer is selected before the mutating step runs.

verificationRecipe.summary: Read back selected layer timing after the alignment run.
steps: Compare affected layer start or in-point timing with the requested CTI alignment.
expectedEvidence: The selected layers report timing consistent with the target CTI.
The mutating step includes verifyAfter and idempotency evidence.

notes: Seeded from Milestone 30 align_layers_to_time validation and later Agent scenario fixture coverage.

promotionHistory.evidence: Milestone 71 seed from existing typed-tool validation and smoke coverage.

notes: Keep this recipe typed-tool-only; raw ExtendScript is not needed for CTI alignment.

solutions.title: Bulk Layer Duplicate Typed Tool

intent.summary: Prefer duplicate_layers for explicit bulk layer duplication after target layers are known.
appliesWhen: The user asks to duplicate, copy or clone multiple explicit layers.
The user asks to duplicate selected layers and selected-layer indices have been inspected first.

inputs.name: layerIndices
inputs.description: Concrete one-based source layer indices for duplicate_layers.

inputs.name: sourceNames
inputs.description: Optional expected source names paired with layerIndices for source guard evidence.

inputs.name: nameSuffix
inputs.description: Optional duplicate name suffix when the user requests one.

targetAssumptions: Explicit bulk duplicate workflows use concrete layerIndices from prior comp or layer inspection.
Selected-layer duplicate workflows require prior get_selected_layers evidence before binding layerIndices.
Deep precomp/source duplication remains a separate workflow and is not part of this guidance.

verificationRecipe.summary: Require duplicate_layers pair/count evidence and post-run comp read-back for expected source and duplicate names.
steps: Run get_selected_layers before selected-layer duplicate plans, or use prior explicit layer inspection for bulk explicit indices.
Run duplicate_layers with concrete layerIndices and optional sourceNames.
Run get_comp_details after mutation and compare source/duplicate names plus before/after layer counts.
expectedEvidence: Selected-layer duplicate plans include get_selected_layers evidence before layerIndices are bound.
duplicate_layers returns one source/duplicate pair for each requested source layer.
Post-run comp read-back shows the expected duplicate names and final layer count.

notes: Backed by M207 generated-only Full UI Agent live validation and M206 local semantic smoke coverage.

promotionHistory.evidence: Milestone 208 solution-library guidance after M204-M207 runtime, planner, semantic, and generated-only live validation.

notes: For selected-layer requests, inspect selection first with get_selected_layers and bind concrete layerIndices from that evidence.
Do not use this guidance for deletion, raw ExtendScript, deep precomp/source duplication, source relinking, mask/path edits, audio workflows, or arbitrary user-asset mutation.

solutions.title: Deep Duplicate Precomp With Fileless Sources

intent.summary: Duplicate a selected precomp source tree even when nested adjustment or generated solid footage has no source file.
appliesWhen: The user asks to deep duplicate a selected precomp/source tree.
Nested sources may include generated solids, adjustment layers, placeholders, or missing footage.

inputs.name: selectedLayer
inputs.description: Optional selected layer or precomp source inspected before mutation.

targetAssumptions: An active composition exists when the workflow targets current selection.
Targets are verified through read tools before mutation.

verificationRecipe.summary: Run read-back tools after the protected run and require semantic verification to pass or report needs-review evidence.
steps: Run the typed plan through dry-run first.
Read back affected comp/layer/source state after mutation.
expectedEvidence: Semantic verification status is passed or not_applicable.
Candidate evidence is stored under local ignored logs.

notes: Auto-promoted only after local registry validation succeeds.

promotionHistory.evidence: Successful Agent Hardcore session passed local candidate and registry validation before becoming planner-visible.

notes: Advisory recipe only; execution still uses normal Agent plan validation, dry-run/run gates, checkpoint/edit-session protection, idempotency, and read-back verification.
